steps.title: Collect dung sample
steps.instruction: Obtain a representative dung sample and secure it for transport.

substeps.instruction: Collect approximately 50 g of dung from multiple directions and regions of the dung pile using a sterile spatula or wooden spoon.
Thoroughly mix the collected material.
Transfer the mixed dung into a sterile plastic container and securely seal the lid; optionally reinforce the seal with Teflon tape.
Place the sealed container in the designated sample collection box.

steps.title: Collect slurry sample
steps.instruction: Gather slurry from the drainage outlet and seal it.

substeps.instruction: Collect 50 mL of slurry into a provided sterile Falcon (centrifuge) tube, sampling from multiple points of the drainage outlet originating from the animal shed.
Seal the tube with Teflon tape to prevent leakage.
Place the sealed tube in the sample collection box.

steps.title: Collect drinking water sample
steps.instruction: Sample drinking water and secure the container.

substeps.instruction: Collect 1 L of drinking water from the animal trough, individual feeding stall, or water trough into a sterile plastic container.
Secure the container lid with Teflon tape before final sealing.
Place the sealed container in the sample collection box.

steps.title: Collect manger swab
steps.instruction: Swab the manger surface and immerse the cloth in buffer.

substeps.instruction: While wearing gloves, use a sterile 10 × 10 cm autoclaved electrostatic dust cloth to thoroughly swab the manger surface, focusing on corners and edges where saliva may accumulate.
Place the used cloth into a 50 mL centrifuge tube that already contains 50 mL of 1× PBS buffer.
Seal the tube and place it in the sample collection box.

steps.title: Collect farm milk sample
steps.instruction: Add milk to a preservative‑pre‑filled tube and seal.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 50 mL Falcon tube pre‑filled with 4.72 mL preservative (LY20).
Add pooled farm milk to reach a final volume of 40 mL, maintaining a ratio of 1.18 mL preservative per 10 mL milk.
Seal the tube and place it in the sample collection box.

steps.title: Collect leftover feed sample
steps.instruction: Gather representative feed remnants and seal.

substeps.instruction: Collect approximately 5–10 g of leftover feed, representing all mangers on the farm, into a sterile Falcon tube.
Seal the tube securely and place it in the sample collection box.

steps.title: Transport and store samples
steps.instruction: Keep all samples cold during transport to the laboratory.

substeps.instruction: Place all sealed sample containers into cooler boxes containing ice packs.
Maintain the temperature at 4 °C throughout transport to the laboratory.
